meta.name: One Day
meta.description:
After spending graduation night together, Emma and Dexter go their separate ways — but their lives remain intertwined.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 8 Feb 2024 · United Kingdom, United States of America · Language: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 1988. On the night of their graduation, Emma and Dexter meet for the first time. It's an evening of almost-romance, and a morning of missed opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: 1989. The year has taken Dex and Em in very different directions. From a villa in Rome and a minibus in the Midlands, they both ponder what comes next.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: 1990. Life in London isn't what Em was expecting. In a creative drought, she's working in a shabby restaurant, where she gets a visit from Dex.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: 1991. On holiday together in Greece, Emma has plans for how to keep things platonic. Dexter would rather reminisce about the night they met.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: 1992. After a heavy night out, a hungover Dexter goes home to visit his family. Shocked at the terrible state he's in, his mother takes him to task.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: 1993. Dex gets his moment in the spotlight, while it's opening night for Em's play. She boosts her actors' confidence, while he suffers a dent to his.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: 1994. The friends go for a glamorous but disastrous dinner together. Dexter's keen to show off his lavish new lifestyle, but Emma isn't impressed.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: 1995. On the last day of the school term, Emma gets into a compromising position at work. When she gets home, things become even more uncomfortable.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: 1996. Dexter wants to impress his new girlfriend's parents, but the visit doesn't go according to plan. Over dinner, he gets a call from his agent.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: 1997. The two bump into each other at a university friend's wedding. After an awkward reunion, they get lost in conversation together.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: 1998. Dexter's still adjusting to domestic life. On an evening in, he finds an old mixtape from Emma and calls her to chat about times gone by.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: 1999. A troubled Dexter visits Emma, who's thriving in Paris. As they wander the streets, the memory of their encounter months before hangs in the air.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: 2000. 2001. 2002. Em and Dex's bond grows tighter as the years pass. Her writing's going well, and he starts his own business.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: 2003. 2004. 2007. Unable to contemplate the future, Dexter looks back on his and Emma's intertwined past — and gets a visit from some familiar faces.
